<!-- title: v2.1.1 – Leaner release asset, simpler download -->
**The release zip now contains only what you need to run the toolkit, and the download path is simpler: verify the zip, unblock the zip, extract. The scripts are functionally unchanged from 2.1.0.**

> The end-to-end lab validation of the 2.x scripts (L1-L20) is in progress ([docs/VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.1.1/docs/VALIDATION.md)). Validate in your own lab first.

## Changed

- **Release asset for users:** `cloudsync-soa-toolkit-2.1.1.zip` contains `scripts/`, the two templates, the documentation for users and reviewers, README, CHANGELOG, SECURITY, LICENSE and `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Tools, tests, CI workflows, editor settings and maintainer documents are no longer in the zip. They remain in the repository and in *Source code (zip)* of this release - use those to review the code or to build and verify the release yourself.
- **Download, verify, unblock:** verify the zip (`gh release verify-asset` against the release attestation, or its SHA-256), then run `Unblock-File` on the zip itself and extract it. You no longer unblock every extracted file. Paths for the GitHub CLI, a browser download, isolated networks and a clone: [docs/SETUP.md, section 3.1](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.1.1/docs/SETUP.md#31-download-verify-and-unblock).

## Upgrade from 2.1.0

1. Extract the zip into a new folder and copy your `SoaToolkit.config.psd1` and `SoaToolkit.terms.txt` into it.
2. Run `.\Install-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step DeployTasks`. The scripts differ from 2.1.0 only in their version lines; deploying them keeps the hosts on the same version as the admin workstation, which `Export-SoaReport.ps1` compares against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Details: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.1.1/CHANGELOG.md)

## Verify the download

Verify the zip before you extract it, then unblock the zip itself - the extracted files then carry no download mark:

```powershell
gh release verify-asset v2.1.1 .\cloudsync-soa-toolkit-2.1.1.zip --repo mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit   # release attestation
Get-FileHash .\cloudsync-soa-toolkit-2.1.1.zip -Algorithm SHA256   # without the GitHub CLI: compare with the .sha256 file and the digest next to the asset
Unblock-File .\cloudsync-soa-toolkit-2.1.1.zip
```

The zip contains `SHA256SUMS.txt` for every file. Tools and tests are in the source code archives. Details: [SETUP, section 3.1](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.1.1/docs/SETUP.md#31-download-verify-and-unblock)

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/compare/v2.1.0...v2.1.1
